segments.vo: Pirates kidnapped Julius Caesar, and he demanded a bigger ransom.
This really happened.
Around seventy-five B C, a ship is crossing the Aegean Sea.
segments.cap: Around 75 BC, a ship is crossing the Aegean Sea.

segments.vo: On board is twenty-five-year-old Julius Caesar, sailing to Rhodes to study public speaking.
segments.cap: On board is 25-year-old Julius Caesar, sailing to Rhodes to study public speaking.

segments.vo: But in the Aegean, pirates seize the ship.
segments.cap: But in the Aegean, pirates seize the ship.

segments.vo: They demand a ransom of twenty talents.
segments.cap: They demand a ransom of 20 talents.

segments.vo: Caesar laughs, and tells them to ask for fifty.
segments.cap: Caesar laughs, and tells them to ask for 50.

segments.vo: He sends his men off to raise the money.
segments.cap: He sends his men off to raise the money.

segments.vo: He stays behind with one friend and two servants.
segments.cap: He stays behind with 1 friend and 2 servants.

segments.vo: He is held for thirty-eight days.
When he wants to sleep, he orders the pirates to be quiet.
segments.cap: When he wants to sleep, he orders the pirates to be quiet.

segments.vo: He joins their games, writes poems and speeches, and makes the pirates listen.
segments.cap: He joins their games, writes poems and speeches, and makes the pirates listen.

segments.vo: And he keeps threatening to execute every last one of them.
segments.cap: And he keeps threatening to execute every last one of them.

segments.vo: The pirates think he's joking.
Finally, the ransom arrives from Myleetus, and Caesar walks free.
segments.cap: Finally, the ransom arrives from Miletus, and Caesar walks free.

segments.vo: But he isn't finished with the pirates.
segments.cap: But he isn't finished with the pirates.

segments.vo: He gathers ships in Myleetus.
Then he sails back, and captures almost all of them.
segments.cap: Then he sails back, and captures almost all of them.

segments.vo: He locks them in prison at Pergamum.
segments.cap: He locks them in prison at Pergamum.

segments.vo: But the Roman governor stalls, with his eye on the pirates' treasure.
segments.cap: But the Roman governor stalls, with his eye on the pirates' treasure.

segments.vo: So Caesar goes to the prison himself, and has them all crucified, just as he promised.
segments.cap: So Caesar goes to the prison himself, and has them all crucified, just as he promised.
